answer: New identities each epoch join one pool; a random draw samples a few, each sampled node runs a signed proof of unique compute tied to its own seed, posting a bond. Failure burns the bond and freezes the pool's vote weight for two epochs - a ridge of friction - so flooding stacks fake accounts into one doomed pool. Attackers pay per puppet: each fake identity risks the draw, funds its bond, and runs its own costly proof at the summit gate; cost scales with N, no bulk discount, honest nodes pass once. An umber audit trail lists burned bonds.
